name: @vssaros/dsh-memory
description: VsSaros memory module for DeepSeek Harness: injects the agent's working memory as a system-prompt section (read-only, via the AgentMemory gateway), exposes 23 memory tools — memory_list / memory_search / memory_stats / memory_refresh / memory_remember / memory_recall / memory_forget / memory_obsidian_export / memory_cascade / memory_crystal / memory_routine / memory_improve / memory_facet / memory_governance / memory_team / memory_mesh / memory_sentinel / memory_api / memory_slot / memory_lesson / memory_work / memory_import / memory_skill — 16 of which change user data and therefore pass the approval gate, auto-distills durable facts from user messages into a human-reviewed draft area (agent/turn-stopping), and serves its own standalone page (/x/memory/, activityBar container agentStudio.memory, order 111). The legacy /x/memory/section fragment route was removed on 2026-10-12 (the knowledge-base page no longer embeds it). Single writer stays the gateway.
